description: An async server function compiled into a public HTTP POST endpoint that can be invoked progressively from forms or called from Client Components to mutate data and revalidate caches.
Next.js form component that prefetches target route layouts and loading states for string actions, converting form submissions into soft client-side URL search parameter navigations.
React hook that binds a Server Action or async form action to component state, returning [state, formAction, isPending] so validation errors and loading states render declaratively.
React hook that projects an immediate speculative UI state while an async action is in flight, automatically reconciling once the server response settles.
Next.js security mechanism that encrypts server-scoped variables bound to inline Server Actions so they cannot be tampered with when round-tripped through hidden form inputs.
